rationale: The reviewer identified plate/run-date confounding with case status as the cause of the inflated AUROC. They measured a plate-only AUROC of 0.887 (~0.91) and found 54/60 cases vs 8/60 controls on plates 1-2 (90% vs 13%, close to 85%/15%). They proposed randomizing across plates, batch-split evaluation, and an independent cohort; the feature-selection leakage they noted is already in the key.
